summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Black and flake8 are not installed, so I only measured line lengths; one over-120 line was wrapped and all others are at most 120. Choices beyond the spec: absent image/label fields are skipped rather than rejected, and a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError.
